tzar.meaningZh: n. 沙皇, 皇帝, 大权独揽的人物, 特权人物
tzar.definition: n a male monarch or emperor (especially of Russia prior to 1917)

tzarevna.meaningZh: n. 旧俄太子妃, 旧俄公主

tzarina.definition: n the wife or widow of a czar

a. 俄国帝制的

plural of tzar
